issues.where: the whole frame: air between camera and peaks
issues.what: the blizzard is gone: no driven snow streaks, no fume off the struck summit, no sea of cloud filling the valleys, no depth haze; distant spires sit crisp on a flat blue-grey backdrop
issues.fix: bring back wind-driven snow across the frame, steam/smoke boiling off the strike point, a cloud sea below the peaks and strong aerial haze so far spires fade

issues.where: the struck summit and the rock face below it
issues.what: the strike lights nothing: no violet bloom on the peak, no glowing ember sparks scattering, the rock is evenly lit grey on all sides instead of dark with a hot violet rim on the lightning side
issues.fix: make the bolt the key light: violet-white flare at the tip, embers flying, violet rim light down the near edge of the spire with the face falling into deep shadow

issues.where: composition and landforms: left foreground and middle distance
issues.what: the out-of-focus, snow-plastered cliff filling the left foreground is replaced by a sharp curved horn; the main spire stands on rounded snow humps instead of a long snow-and-rock ridge falling right; distant spires are a row of similar cones on mounds rather than a few isolated fins rising out of cloud; no shallow depth of field
issues.fix: restore a large soft-focus snowy rock wall at frame left, the summit ridge descending to lower right, and a few sparse dark fins far off emerging from cloud, with foreground and background defocused

issues.what: sky is a flat, even lilac-blue wash with soft painted texture; target has heavy dark storm cloud with violet-lit billows near the bolt and a narrow orange sunset band low on the horizon; -b's orange is a vague smear at right mid-height
issues.fix: darken and structure the storm clouds, light their undersides violet near the bolt, and put a thin bright orange horizon band low behind the far peaks

issues.where: the ribbons streaming from the summit
issues.what: ribbons are opaque matte white-grey bands with no translucency, no violet glow or crackling arcs, and the many fine dark tethering strands are reduced to a couple; extra ribbons on the left horn and distant spires not in target
issues.fix: make the main ribbon translucent and lit violet with electrical crackle at its tip, tethered by many fine dark lines down the face; remove the extra ribbons elsewhere

issues.what: rock reads as a smooth CG shell with tiled noise texture and a soft outline; target has fractured, jointed granite with sharp ledges, warm brown tones under snow, wet sheen and snow caught on ledges
issues.fix: model deep fractures and ledges, warmer brown-grey stone, snow lodged in cracks, crisper silhouettes

issues.what: target is a dim, warm cave with glossy wet rock lit from the mouth, icicles catching violet light and the animals rimmed by cold light; -b is flatly and evenly lit everywhere with no light falloff from the mouth, no shadow on the interior, no wet sheen
issues.fix: light the cave from the mouth only: cool violet rim on icicles and fur near the opening, falloff to darker warm shadow deeper inside, specular wet highlights on rock and ice

issues.what: the outside lacks the storm: no blowing snow, no haze, no violet-lit cloud, no ribbons streaming from the peak; the landform is a low jagged range seen crisply instead of a single tall spire rising above a snowfield with tracks and boulders; an incongruous lightning bolt and small flying shape are added
issues.fix: show one tall spire with ribbons trailing right, a snowy slope with footprints and rocks running out of the cave, driven snow and haze, violet glow in the clouds and a thin orange horizon

issues.what: walls are a uniform fuzzy brushed texture like fur or frost, not the smooth, layered, water-polished warm rock of the target; the arch is a clean tube shape
issues.fix: replace with smooth banded rock in warm tan/grey, glazed with ice and meltwater, irregular arch, icicle curtain hanging from the rim of the mouth

issues.what: floor is a flat, smooth blue plane meeting the outside along a straight edge; target floor is wet, frozen meltwater with reflections, slush, pebbles and a large rock at right, rising into snow drifts at the mouth
issues.fix: break up the floor with wet ice, reflections of the mouth light, slush and stones, and let it blend into drifted snow at the opening

issues.what: fewer animals and they lie as flat fur mounds out in the open, mid-frame; target packs several frosted shaggy bodies tight against the left wall, one very close and soft-focus at frame left, claws visible; fur in -b is clumped, hard-edged texture without frost tips or rim light (crop x29-46%, y54-71%)
issues.fix: crowd more animals against the left wall with a large out-of-focus one in the foreground, frosted fine hair, rim-lit by the cave mouth

issues.what: everything is sharp; target uses shallow focus with soft foreground fur
